name: Generation Thrive
description: Free meeting rooms and coworking space in Oakland and San Francisco for registered Bay Area nonprofits; priority for Warriors Community Foundation and select Kaiser Permanente grantees
fullDescription: Generation Thrive, from the Warriors Community Foundation and Kaiser Permanente, provides free meeting and coworking space to registered Bay Area nonprofits at two sites: downtown Oakland (1011 Broadway, in the Oakland Marriott City Center) and San Francisco (1725 3rd St, in Chase Center's Thrive City).
whatTheyOffer:
- Free conference rooms for up to 40 guests
- Single-day coworking reservations (up to 5 people, once a week)
- Free high-speed WiFi and hybrid meeting setup
- Outside food and drinks allowed (no alcohol)
- Non-grantees can book conference rooms once a month (up to 2 days)
- Priority for Warriors Community Foundation and select Kaiser grantees
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a registered Bay Area 501(c)(3) nonprofit
2. Submit a space request on the Generation Thrive website (one request per day of use)
3. Describe your organization and meeting needs
4. A tour may be required for larger or complex events
5. Wait for approval and confirmation
6. Share your guest list before the event; all guests check in on arrival
keywords: Generation Thrive, Warriors, Kaiser, free meeting space, nonprofit venue, conference room, coworking, event space
